properties.name: What a claim rests on lists only its own support, never the premises of objections against its foundations, and a step used as a premise is never an uncited premise
properties.statement:
reasoning_report's rests_on and uncited_premises for a claim list only what supports it. The premises of objections against the claim or its foundations are listed apart, as what stands against it. A step (Inference) used as a premise is not listed as an uncited premise.
MEASURED 2026-10-19 in the trolley trial: "Switch: turning permissible" was said to rest on the Footbridge judgment, a premise of an objection against one of its principles, and steps used as premises were listed among the "uncited premises".
